title: SpeechRail diarization extension contract (SPK-E2E-1, version 1)
description: The diarization object echoed under session.speechrail.diarization in transcription_session.updated after a successful speechrail.diarization.v1 negotiation. The runtime declares the negotiated version, the four-slot public cap and the enabled flag; timebase details live in the completed/update events, not here.
